summary: Configured a persistent NFS share from node1 to node2 with consistent dataops identity, ownership, permissions, bidirectional access, and verified restart persistence on both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed NFS utilities on both nodes.
Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Exported /srv/nfs/shared from node1 to node2 with rw,sync,no_subtree_check.
Set /srv/nfs/shared ownership to dataops:dataops and mode 2770.
Enabled NFS, SELinux NFS write access, and the NFS firewall service on node1.
Mounted the export at /mnt/shared on node2 and persisted it in /etc/fstab.
Verified bidirectional file creation with UID/GID 4500 and mode 660.
Restarted nodes one at a time and verified changed boot identities, service recovery, persistent mounting, preserved data, and post-restart writes.

evidence.summary: Direct identity output confirms dataops is 4500:4500 on both nodes before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared with dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770
evidence.summary: Shows the live restricted read-write export, correct directory metadata, enabled/active NFS service, firewall allowance, and recovered export after restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 persistently mounts the share at /mnt/shared
evidence.summary: Shows the NFSv4 mount, persistent fstab entry, correct mounted-directory metadata, and automatic recovery after restart.

evidence.requirement: Files created on either system retain consistent ownership and permissions
evidence.summary: Files created from both nodes are visible cross-node as dataops:dataops (4500:4500) with mode 660.
Captures healthy baseline boot 314b3611…, acknowledged reboot, temporary disconnect, changed boot 84f53ae0…, recovered service/export/data, and a successful client write through the recovered server.
Captures healthy baseline boot 4d842549…, acknowledged reboot, temporary unavailability, changed boot ae84fa4d…, automatic mount recovery, preserved data, and a successful post-restart write.
